title: My Half-Brother Stole $90K, Fled The State, And Blocked Me. So I Let The Law Handle It.
description: My half-brother begged for my $90,000 nursing pension, promised in writing to repay with interest, then disappeared and reopened his bakery under his wife's name. I tracked him down through a pie contest flyer, enforced the court judgment, and renamed his bakery 'Crust of Consequences.' Now he scrubs mixing bowls wearing a 'Rolled Over My Trust' shirt. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY $90K PENSION, I RENAMED HIS BAKERY
pinned_comment: What would you have done if your half-brother stole your $90K nursing pension, fled the state, and reopened his bakery under his wife's name? Tell me your story in the comments.
